Name: Shelemiah, Son of Abdeel
Summary: Shelemiah, son of Abdeel, was one of the officers Jehoiakim sent to seize Jeremiah and Baruch after the scroll was burned, but the Lord hid them.
KeyStory: The king commanded Shelemiah son of Abdeel to take Jeremiah and Baruch, but the Lord hid them.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: Orders to arrest God's messengers fail when God himself is the hiding place.
